finding: Correctly extends mixinDelegatesAria(HelixElement), uses static formAssociated = true override, and delegates _onFormDisabled properly.
All public properties use @property with correct type, reflect where necessary, and document @attr in JSDoc. hx-size attribute mapping for size is consistent.
hx-click dispatched with bubbles:true, composed:true, structured detail {originalEvent}, and gated on disabled/loading state.
Uses classMap, ifDefined, nothing, and separate _renderInner/_renderSpinner helpers. Dual render path (anchor vs button) is clean with no anti-patterns.
Variant clamping is performed in updated() rather than willUpdate(), causing an extra render cycle when an invalid variant is corrected.
recommendation: Move variant validation from updated() into willUpdate() using changedProperties.has('variant') to avoid the extra re-render.

finding: Full ElementInternals implementation: setFormValue on input, setValidity with valueMissing/tooShort/tooLong, anchor element passed, formReset/formStateRestore/formDisabled all implemented.
Uses live() directive on the value binding to prevent stale DOM state on controlled updates. All properties correctly typed and reflected where needed.

Help-text rendering block has duplicated logic: the same slot+div structure is rendered in two separate branches (_hasHelpTextSlot and helpText && !hasError), creating template duplication that diverges over time.
recommendation: Consolidate the help-text render path into a single helper method _renderHelpText() to eliminate the duplication.

finding: Uses @query for _input reference, avoiding direct shadowRoot.querySelector. FocusMixin properly delegates focus. Styles in dedicated styles file.
Default slot rendered with inline style='display:none;' in template (line 731). This violates the constraint against inline styles in templates, and is not portable to themes that override display.
recommendation: Replace inline style="display:none;" with a CSS class (e.g. .field__options-source) in hx-select.styles.ts that sets display:none, applied via class binding.

finding: connectedCallback() calls super.connectedCallback() and does nothing else — the method body is effectively empty and should be removed to reduce noise.
recommendation: Remove the empty connectedCallback() override; it provides no value and suggests incomplete implementation.

finding: Correctly uses HelixElement._internals with formAssociated, implements all form lifecycle hooks (_onFormReset, _onFormStateRestore, _onFormDisabled), and maintains validity via _updateValidity.

The open property uses @property({ type: Boolean, reflect: true }) which means the combobox open state is visible as a DOM attribute; this is intentional for CSS selectors but the JSDoc should note the styling hook explicitly.
recommendation: Add a note to the open JSDoc that it is reflected for CSS selectors (:host([open])) and Drupal Twig compatibility to prevent consumers from treating it as purely internal state.

finding: hx-dialog extends LitElement directly instead of HelixElement. It therefore loses the lazy _internals accessor, standardised form lifecycle delegation, and the base class conventions used by all other components.
recommendation: Migrate hx-dialog to extend HelixElement for consistency with the rest of the library. Even though hx-dialog is not form-associated, extending HelixElement keeps the inheritance chain uniform and future-proofs the component.

finding: disconnectedCallback correctly calls super and unlocks body scroll. updated() drives open/close via property change. firstUpdated() validates heading accessibility. All lifecycle methods call super.
hx-open, hx-close, and hx-cancel all use bubbles:true, composed:true. hx-cancel fires before hx-close per documented behavior. Native cancel event is suppressed correctly.
Uses @query for _dialogEl, avoids direct shadowRoot.querySelector. Focus trap correctly traverses slotted light DOM via assignedElements(). Body scroll lock uses shared reference-counted utility.
hx-tabs extends LitElement directly instead of HelixElement, deviating from the established base class convention used by all form-interactive and interactive components.
recommendation: Migrate hx-tabs to extend HelixElement to maintain a consistent inheritance chain across the library.

finding: connectedCallback/disconnectedCallback correctly add/remove event listeners and disconnect MutationObserver. MutationObserver used for panel/name attribute changes. firstUpdated handles pending selected-index from SSR/Drupal Twig correctly.

_activePanel is @state but selectedIndex is a plain JS getter/setter, not a reactive property. Setting selectedIndex programmatically activates the tab but does not schedule a re-render through Lit's change detection if no @state is updated.
recommendation: Verify that _activateTab() always updates _activePanel (which is @state) to guarantee re-render. Current code does update _activePanel, so this is low-risk but the pattern is non-obvious and worth a code comment.

finding: Template is minimal and clean. Two slots with slotchange handlers. ARIA attributes (role=tablist, aria-orientation, aria-label) correctly placed. No anti-patterns.

willUpdate() correctly recomputes tick cache when config changes. updated() clamps value and syncs form state. firstUpdated() captures default value for form reset. requestAnimationFrame used correctly for data-ready transition suppression.
Tick marks rendered with ticks.map() instead of the repeat() directive. For large step counts with fine granularity this can cause O(n) DOM reconciliation on every render instead of keyed updates.
recommendation: Replace ticks.map() with repeat(ticks, (pct) => pct, ...) to enable keyed rendering for tick mark elements.

finding: value reflected for CSS selectors, size uses hx-size attribute mapping, valueText correctly maps aria-valuetext via @property. Custom converter not needed; all types are primitives.
setFormValue called in updated() and event handlers. _onFormReset restores to captured _defaultValue. _onFormStateRestore validates and clamps. formDisabled propagates to disabled property.
Form value correctly null when unchecked (like a native checkbox), non-null when checked. Validity management for required constraint. All form lifecycle hooks implemented.
checked, disabled, required, name, value all properly reflected. size uses hx-size attribute mapping consistently with other components.

help-text is only rendered when helpText && !hasError; when hasErrorSlot is true but helpText is empty the help-text wrapper is omitted, which may produce an inconsistent layout. The _hasErrorSlot state is tracked but the error div does not always render with the stable ID.
recommendation: Ensure the help-text wrapper always renders with its stable id=${this._helpTextId} so aria-describedby references remain valid even when toggling between error and help-text states.

finding: firstUpdated() uses console.warn directly instead of the library's devWarn() utility, breaking consistency with every other component. devWarn is suppressible in production and prefixed with component tag; console.warn is not.
recommendation: Replace console.warn('[hx-toggle-button] ...') with devWarn('hx-toggle-button', '...') to match the library-wide pattern.

finding: label property is typed string | undefined; when undefined the template binds aria-label=${this.label ?? nothing} which correctly removes the attribute. However label=undefined is an unusual sentinel — a pattern of label='' with empty-string check may be more idiomatic.
recommendation: Consider normalising label to string | undefined consistently and documenting the nothing sentinel behavior in the JSDoc. Current behavior is correct but non-obvious.

finding: Extends HelixElement with formAssociated, correctly overrides all form lifecycle hooks. _syncFormValue uses setFormValue with second state argument 'pressed' for reliable formStateRestoreCallback detection.
Extends LitElement directly instead of HelixElement. While hx-top-nav is not form-associated, the deviation from the established base class convention is inconsistent.
recommendation: Migrate hx-top-nav to extend HelixElement for consistency with the library base class convention.

finding: connectedCallback/disconnectedCallback correctly manage keydown listener. Escape key handler returns focus to mobile-toggle button. Focus management uses updateComplete.then() correctly for async DOM access.
hx-mobile-toggle dispatched with bubbles:true, composed:true on both open and Escape-close. Event detail { open: boolean } is structured, not a raw DOM event.

Comprehensive validation: valueMissing, rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, stepMismatch all implemented with floating-point epsilon guard. Stepper uses _clearLongPress in disconnectedCallback to prevent memory leaks.
disconnectedCallback calls _clearLongPress() to clean up setTimeout/setInterval resources. firstUpdated captures _defaultValue for form reset. updated() performs NaN guard with early return.
Custom converter on value handles null/empty attribute correctly, bridging the Number coercion gap for nullable numeric properties. reflect:true on value is appropriate for CSS selectors.
setFormValue uses null when value is empty (matching checkbox/radio convention). All form lifecycle hooks implemented. Individual disabled states preserved in WeakMap before group-level override.

fieldset has role='radiogroup' but fieldset already has implicit group semantics in HTML5; adding role='radiogroup' is redundant and overrides the native fieldset/legend relationship. This may confuse some ATs that expect the fieldset/legend pairing.
recommendation: Remove role='radiogroup' from the <fieldset> element and rely on the native fieldset + legend relationship. If a non-fieldset wrapper is desired, replace with a <div role='radiogroup'> and a separate <legend>/<span> as the accessible label.

finding: value and name are reflected for form participation. orientation reflects for CSS selectors. All properties documented with @attr.

Slot change listeners in firstUpdated() are registered imperatively via addEventListener rather than using Lit's @slotchange template binding. This is inconsistent with the rest of the library and bypasses Lit's event delegation.
recommendation: Convert actionsSlot and titleSlot change tracking to use @slotchange=${this._handleActionsSlotChange} bindings in the template, then use @state() booleans. Remove the imperative addEventListener calls and the corresponding stored handler references.

finding: hx-alert extends LitElement directly instead of HelixElement, deviating from the established convention. This is the fourth component (with hx-dialog, hx-tabs, hx-top-nav, hx-split-button) that extends LitElement directly.
recommendation: Migrate to extend HelixElement. This is a non-breaking change and improves consistency.

finding: The double-microtask announcement pattern (Promise.resolve().then(() => Promise.resolve().then())) in updated() is a Lit anti-pattern. Lit's updateComplete promise should be preferred for post-render operations.
recommendation: Replace the nested Promise.resolve() microtask chain with void this.updateComplete.then(() => { /* announcer injection */ }) to use Lit's lifecycle API correctly.

finding: Uses static shadowRootOptions = { delegatesFocus: true } correctly for interactive card focus delegation. Slot change tracking via @slotchange handlers. No inline styles.

hx-card extends LitElement directly instead of HelixElement. As a content component (not form-associated), this is lower risk than form components, but the inconsistency across the library (5 components now extend LitElement) creates a maintenance burden.
recommendation: Migrate hx-card to extend HelixElement. No form-association is needed; simply changing the base class is sufficient.

finding: connectedCallback registers document-level click and keydown listeners unconditionally on every connect, even when the menu is closed. This means every hx-split-button instance adds a document listener even when idle.
recommendation: Register the document-level outside-click handler lazily in _openMenu() and remove it eagerly in _closeMenu(), matching the pattern used by hx-select. This reduces listener count from O(instances) to O(open menus).

finding: hx-split-button extends LitElement directly. This is the sixth component in the sampled set deviating from the HelixElement convention.
recommendation: Migrate to extend HelixElement for consistency.

finding: hx-time-picker uses a private static _instanceCount class field for ID generation instead of the library's shared createIdCounter() utility. The two mechanisms can produce conflicting IDs under SSR or test isolation because createIdCounter supports resetIdCounter() for test cleanup while the static counter does not.
recommendation: Replace `private static _instanceCount = 0` and the inline counter logic with `const _nextTimePicker = createIdCounter('hx-time-picker')` at module scope and `private readonly _id = _nextTimePicker()` as the instance field, matching the pattern used in hx-select, hx-slider, and hx-text-input.

finding: connectedCallback/disconnectedCallback correctly manage document-level outside-click listener. willUpdate() updates display value before render. updated() syncs form value and validity. All lifecycle calls super correctly.

The listbox options are only rendered inside the repeat() when this._open is true, which means the aria-controls target (`this._listboxId`) is in the DOM but empty when closed. This is intentional per the comment, but the active-descendant ID could reference an absent element during the transition frame.
recommendation: The current approach is acceptable, but document the intentional DOM-visible/empty-content pattern in a code comment referencing WCAG 4.1.2 compliance rationale.

finding: setFormValue and _updateValidity correctly implemented. formStateRestoreCallback clamps restored value to min/max bounds. formReset clears display value and closes listbox.

6 of 10 sampled components (hx-dialog, hx-tabs, hx-top-nav, hx-alert, hx-card, hx-split-button) extend LitElement directly rather than HelixElement. The HelixElement base class provides lazy ElementInternals, form lifecycle delegation, and standardised validity getters. Bypassing it creates maintenance divergence and prevents future base-class enhancements from propagating automatically.
recommendation: Establish a migration task to extend all LitElement-extending components to HelixElement. This is a non-breaking change for non-form-associated components. Prioritise hx-dialog and hx-card as the highest-traffic components.

finding: All sampled components use two-level CSS custom property fallbacks (--hx-component-*, var(--hx-semantic-*)) with no hardcoded color or spacing values observed in component classes. Styles correctly placed in separate *.styles.ts files.

The hx-size attribute convention (using attribute:'hx-size' to avoid colliding with native size attribute) is consistently applied across hx-button, hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-slider, hx-switch, hx-toggle-button, hx-split-button. This is an excellent pattern but is not documented in any shared convention guide.
recommendation: Document the hx-size attribute convention in CONTRIBUTING.md or the base component template so new components implement it consistently.

finding: 8 of 10 sampled components have medium or higher issues. No component has critical (0-2) issues. Top systemic problems: (1) 6 of 10 components extend LitElement directly instead of HelixElement base class — the highest-frequency systemic deviation; (2) hx-time-picker uses a non-standard instance counter instead of the shared createIdCounter() utility, risking ID collision in tests; (3) hx-alert uses imperative slot-change listeners in firstUpdated() instead of @slotchange template bindings, and uses nested microtask promises instead of updateComplete.
recommendation: 1. Migrate all LitElement-extending components to HelixElement (non-breaking for non-form-associated components, approximately 20-30 min each). 2. Replace hx-time-picker private static _instanceCount with createIdCounter() to restore test-isolation safety. 3. Refactor hx-alert slot tracking to use @slotchange template bindings and replace nested Promise.resolve() with updateComplete.then() for idiomatic Lit patterns.
